title: Warm Gooey Uruguayan Beef Skewers
description: A hearty Uruguayan dish featuring tender beef skewers grilled to perfection and served with a side of gooey Italian-seasoned sauce, perfect for a post-workout meal.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the beef strips onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, mix together the Italian seasoning, olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the mixture onto both sides of the beef skewers.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees.
While the skewers are cooking, heat the tomato paste in a donabe over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and red bell pepper to the donabe and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the beef broth to the donabe and stir to combine.
Once the skewers are cooked, remove them from the grill and place them in the donabe with the sauce.
Simmer the skewers in the sauce for 2-3 minutes, until the sauce has thickened and the beef is coated.
